title: HTML injection in personal message notification emails via participant names
summary:
### Impact

Notification emails for personal messages list the other participants as links. User and group names were inserted into these emails without sanitization, so a name containing HTML or Markdown was rendered as markup in the emails other participants receive, for example to add images, restyle the email or insert misleading links.

A group full name can be set by group owners, so this works with default settings for any group that is invited to a personal message. A user's own full name is only used when `prioritize_username_in_ux` is disabled. Sites where an admin customized the email header, footer or preview text to include `%{topic_title}` were also affected through topic titles.

### Patches

The email snippets are now sanitized and participant names are escaped. Fixed in `2026.11.0-latest`. Fixed release versions will be added after the fix and backports are released.

### Workarounds

Keep `prioritize_username_in_ux` enabled, and avoid `%{topic_title}` in customized email header, footer or preview texts. There is no workaround for group full names other than reviewing the full names of groups with non-staff owners.

### References

None.
